parsed.post: Discarding the recent attempt to increase DEPTH to 8 (0.8886 vs 0.8850). It seems scaling capacity too much without adjustments to warmup or LR causes instability within the 5-minute window. Reverting to DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=64. Next, I will try increasing the MATRIX_LR slightly to see if the higher capacity requires more aggressive updates.
parsed.description: Slightly increasing learning rate to 0.1 to see if it helps the higher capacity model (6x64) converge better within the 5-minute budget.
